name: Cockatrix · Gremlet #50
description:
A cockatrice chick: half chick, half lizard, all attitude. Its glare is mostly bluff.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Cockatrix in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
